slides.texte_overlay:
red flags in your own habits
you should fix this year

checking your phone first

reaching for your phone before your eyes are even open hands your mood to other people. give yourself ten quiet minutes first, and your mornings will change.

never learning anything new

if you can't remember the last thing you learned just for fun, your mind is running on autopilot. even 5 minutes a day of learning something new wakes it back up.
slides.texte_sophia:
never learning anything new

i realised i hadn't learned anything new in years. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a planet or a painting, and i feel awake again.

slides.texte_overlay:
saying yes to everything

agreeing to every plan and favour leaves no time for yourself. a kind and simple no is a habit that protects your energy and makes your yes mean more.

skipping meals then snacking

skipping proper meals and grazing all day leaves you tired and moody. regular, simple meals keep your energy and your focus steady from morning to night.

replaying conversations

going over old conversations in bed every night keeps you stuck in the past. write the thought down once, close the notebook and let it go until tomorrow.
